input: Download offline maps for my hiking trip

gold.taskTitle: Download Offline Maps for Upcoming Hiking Trip
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to download offline maps in preparation for a hiking trip, ensuring navigation access without cellular or internet connectivity.

questions.title: Which specific region or trail are you hiking?
questions.description: Identify the exact geographic area, trail name, or park so the correct map coverage can be downloaded.

questions.title: Which app do you plan to use for navigation?
questions.description: Determine the mapping app the user prefers, such as AllTrails, Gaia GPS, Google Maps, or Maps.me, as download steps vary by platform.

questions.title: What device will you use on the trail?
questions.description: Establish whether the user is on iOS or Android, and the specific device, to ensure compatibility and sufficient storage.

questions.title: How many days is the hiking trip?
questions.description: Understand the trip duration to gauge how large an area needs to be covered and how many map tiles to download.

questions.title: What level of map detail do you need?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user needs basic trail outlines, topographic contour lines, elevation data, or satellite imagery overlays.

questions.title: Do you have enough storage space on your device?
questions.description: Check whether the user knows their available storage, as offline maps can range from hundreds of megabytes to several gigabytes.

questions.title: When does your hiking trip start?
questions.description: Establish the departure date so a realistic deadline for completing the download can be set.
